pages.text: Places a block at a position.$(br2)The position must hold air or a replaceable block like grass or water, otherwise INVALID_ARGUMENT is raised. This needs allowBlockChanges or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised.

$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the block goes$(li)$(1)id$() STRING: the block ID, e.g. minecraft:stone$(li)$(1)properties$() HASH STRING: block states such as facing (optional, default empty)
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/PLACE_BLOCK$(br)  PARAMETER position spot ;$(br)  PARAMETER id "minecraft:torch" ;$()
